# s-soltys/LipSync benchmark assets

Vendored from https://github.com/s-soltys/LipSync for comparative acoustic benchmarking.
The neural-network weights and adapted runtime are released under the Unlicense; see `LICENSE`.
Upstream commit: 55065675bd784116188bd540e3a26c2c45a90a6a

This candidate has nine non-silence output classes and does not natively cover the full
15-class HeadAudio ontology. Benchmark reports therefore include strict accuracy and
ontology-collapsed accuracy separately.
